name: tugite
description: Tugite workflows: explain-this, review-propose, impl-plan, impl-review, impl-lead, test-report, test-verify, visualize-that. Supporting workers, reviewers, and advisors are included.

interface.longDescription: Tugite workflows: explain-this, review-propose, impl-plan, impl-review, impl-lead, test-report, test-verify, visualize-that. Supporting workers, reviewers, and advisors are included.
defaultPrompt: Use $visualize-that only when explicitly requested; turn arbitrary supplied material into meaning-preserving standalone visual HTML, then return verified or render-unverified according to available launch, capture, and actual inspection capability.

Use $test-report when explicitly requested or when the user clearly wants to understand a specified set of tests; report full-scope behavior details and grounded static findings separately from runtime hypotheses and unknowns, with selectable handoff, without editing or running tests.

Use $test-verify only when explicitly requested; revalidate a report or direct bounded target, verify from grounded runtime evidence, repair only authorized target-causal Problems, apply changed-test acceptance and Completion Gate when applicable, and run final verification. No-change needs no change review or empty commit; commit authority is separate from verification.
Use $install-custom-agents to check, install, or update the bundled custom agents.

Use $explain-this only when explicitly requested. Select major nodes in the requested processing flow and write one short identifier-first contribution statement for each. Match each statement to that unit's actual responsibility. Before returning, remove implementation-internal explanations; preserve essential handoffs, ordering and unknown bridges. Keep extra detail to explicit requests, then stop.
Use $review-propose only when explicitly requested. Preserve the original plan; return a coherent alternative and grounded comparison for Human choice, without adopting or implementing it.
Use $impl-plan only when explicitly requested. Concretize the supplied plan into faithful serial implementation units and delegation documents for Human inspection; stop before implementation.

Use $impl-review only when explicitly requested. Review the designated or context-grounded implementation diff using shared specialist, test, and writing criteria; return a correction table and stop before changes.
Use $impl-lead only when explicitly requested to execute prepared delegation documents after live readiness checks, with Parent QA, gates, final verification, and safe integration.
